Deanne, saw Prove launched its Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world.

A platform launch that big usually means more in-market accounts than the revenue team can cover before the new motion ramps, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Deanne, quick follow-up for Prove.

With a new platform live, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount in the field. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Deanne, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to similar teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
